summary: Comprehensive implementation plan to transform and simplify the application into an end-to-end AI-Powered E-Learning Development, Distribution & Analytics Platform. Streamlines the interface to remove cloud-monitoring noise and establishes a unified 3-pillar product structure: Author (7-step AI creation & visual editor), Deliver (LMS learner dashboard, interactive player & AI role-play), and Analyse (decision-oriented analytics, AI insights & remediation).
